title: Long-Distance Relationship
aliases: long distance relationship kibhabe tikiye rakhbo
summary: A long-distance relationship is one where partners live far apart. It works best with regular communication, trust, shared plans to meet, and an eventual plan to close the distance.
do: Plan visits or a future together
dont: Demand constant check-ins or location tracking
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
